title: Italian Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful Italian-inspired dish made with marinated chicken breast, bell peppers, onions, and aromatic spices, grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper to make the marinade.
Add the sliced chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Thread the chicken, bell peppers, and onions onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
